translation: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
1 We sent it [Quran] down on the Night of Destiny.
2 And what will make you comprehend what the Night of Destiny is?
3 The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months
4 on that night, the angels and the Spirit come down by the permission of their Lord with His decrees for all matters
5 it is all peace till the break of dawn.
